info.name: Fintrack
info.description:
## Milestone 4 & 5 - Fintrack API Smoke Tests & Error Handling Documentation

Koleksi ini berisi pengujian mandiri (*smoke testing*) untuk seluruh endpoint REST API Fintrack beserta contoh respon sukses dan berbagai skenario error handling bawaan NestJS backend.

### Modul Utama:
- **Auths**: Register, Login (Rate Limited), Me, Refresh Token, Logout.
- **Users**: Listing (Admin Only), Detail User, Update, & Delete.
- **Accounts**: Account Management (BANK, E_WALLET, CASH).
- **Categories**: Category Management (INCOME, EXPENSE).
- **Transactions**: Financial Transactions dengan pengecekan saldo (*Insufficient funds*).
